label: Proposition 42
title: Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes. Initiative Constitutional Amendment.
q: Prohibits any new state tax (1) imposed on the ownership of personal property (all things people own other than real estate), or (2) that applies retroactively based on taxpayer’s past activities. Nullifies taxes enacted after January 1, 2026 that conflict with this measure. Fiscal Impact: Possibility that tax revenues will not go up as much in the future.
yes: The state could not establish new taxes on the ownership of financial assets or other personal property.
no: The state would continue to have the option to establish new taxes on the ownership of financial assets or other personal property.
